critical_code_review_comments: Manufacturing number generation in fabrica.py (lines 166-172) correctly uses MongoDB counter with upsert for sequential numbering
DespieceModal.jsx has new 'Puertas Proveedor' tab (data-testid='tab-puertas-proveedor') with editable door dimensions table
Export CSV and PDF buttons for supplier doors working (data-testid='export-puertas-csv', 'export-puertas-pdf')
UserManualModal.jsx getSectionsForUser() function (lines 326-369) correctly filters sections based on canAccessFabrica, canAccessMontajes permissions

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 priority features verified working. Manufacturing numbers are sequential integers stored in manufacturingNumber field. DespieceModal accessed via orange DESPIECE button (data-testid='despiece-btn') in budget header when items are added. UserManualModal accessed via AYUDA link in sidebar.

1_manufacturing_number.details: Manufacturing number (manufacturingNumber) is generated sequentially when creating factory orders via POST /api/fabrica/orders. Displayed as 'Nº FAB: X' badge on order cards in Portal de Fábrica. Backend uses MongoDB counter collection for sequential numbering.

2_puertas_proveedor_tab.details: New 'PUERTAS PROVEEDOR' tab in DespieceModal with: editable door dimensions (alto, ancho), veta selector (V/H), color field, observaciones field. Export buttons: CSV (export-puertas-csv) and PDF (export-puertas-pdf). Shows summary by type (P. ALTOS, P. BAJOS, P. COLUMNAS).

3_dynamic_help_manual.details: UserManualModal filters sections based on user permissions using getSectionsForUser() function. Checks canAccessFabrica for 'Portal de Fábrica' section, canAccessMontajes for 'Agenda de Montajes' section. Admin user sees all 8 sections.
